ResearchScope: Research whether first-level timing and direct-opponent solo-kill frequency describe one coherent early-pressure concept.

Definitions.LevelDifference: (FirstLevelForA - FirstLevelForB) / SampleSize; Unknown remains in the SampleSize denominator.
Definitions.SoloDifference: SoloKillsBefore15ForA / SampleSize - SoloKillsBefore15ForB / SampleSize; EVENT_COUNT per match, not probability.
Definitions.OutcomeSeparation: Game wins and OutcomeAdvantage are excluded from every lane-pressure model input.

Reasons: L2 and L3 are correlated and should not be counted as fully independent votes.
Solo kills are event frequency and represent combat pressure rather than level tempo.
Keeping Level Tempo and Combat Pressure separate preserves observed disagreement instead of hiding it in one score.
Use categorical tendencies with Neutral and InsufficientEvidence; do not create an arbitrary numeric score.
Recommendation.StateTerms: 경향 / 뚜렷한 차이 없음 / 판정 보류

Limitations: Aggregate data cannot provide a true train/test split or per-match stability test.
Observed metrics omit CS, gold, XP differences, turret plates, objectives, roams, damage, assists, and third-party deaths.
JUNGLE and SUPPORT are not always well described by the term lane pressure.
Role-specific rules were not fitted; all roles use the same research candidates.
Outcome agreement is diagnostic only and disagreement is not treated as model error.
